rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Rules tidy up transactions for you: when a transaction matches a rule's conditions, its actions run. Rules run from top to bottom and never change what you set by hand. Both members of a household share them.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Create one to categorize, rename or tag transactions automatically.
rules.filter-category-label: Filter by the category a rule sets
rules.order-hint: Rules run from top to bottom. Drag a rule, or use the arrows, to change the order.
rules.order-filtered: Clear the search and filter to change the order.
rules.order-stale: The rules changed in the meantime. The list is up to date now; try again.
rules.save-error: The rule could not be saved.
rules.reorder-error: The new order could not be saved.
rules.limit-reached: A household can have up to {max} rules.
rules.delete-description: The rule stops running. Transactions it already changed stay as they are.

editor.description: Choose which transactions the rule matches and what it does to them. The preview shows your transactions it would match.
editor.name: Name
editor.conditions-limit: A rule can have up to {max} conditions.
editor.type-merchant: Type a merchant name to use it
editor.saved-merchant: The merchant saved with this rule
editor.notes-hint: Only fills notes that are empty.
editor.stop-processing-hint: When this rule matches a transaction, the rules below it do not run on it.
editor.duplicate-actions: Each kind of action can appear only once.

preview.title: Preview
preview.incomplete: Complete the conditions and actions to see which transactions match.
preview.error: The preview is not available right now.
preview.matches: {count, plural, =0 {No transactions match} one {# transaction matches} other {# transactions match}}
preview.changes: {count, plural, =0 {none would change} one {# would change} other {# would change}}
preview.sample: {count, plural, one {The most recent match} other {The # most recent matches}}
preview.protected-hint: A match stays as it is when it already has these values, or where you set the value by hand.
preview.scope-hint: Judged on its own, on the transactions you can see. Saving does not change existing transactions; after saving, you can apply the rule to them.

errors.amount-invalid: Enter an amount of 0 or more, with at most 4 decimals.

rules.from-transaction-hint: Handle transactions like this one automatically.

export.hint: Download this household's rules as a JSON file.
export.error: The rules could not be exported.

import.title: Import rules
import.description: Choose a WonderMoney rules file. Nothing changes until you confirm.
import.file-hint: A JSON file exported from WonderMoney, up to 1 MB.
import.file-invalid: That file is not valid JSON.
import.file-too-large: The file is larger than 1 MB.
import.mode-label: What to do with the rules already here
import.mode-append: Keep them and add the imported rules
import.mode-replace: Replace them with the imported rules
import.replace-warning: {count, plural, =0 {There are no rules to replace.} one {This removes the # rule already here.} other {This removes the # rules already here.}}
import.review-error: The file could not be checked.
import.creates: {count, plural, =0 {No rules will be created} one {# rule will be created} other {# rules will be created}}
import.duplicates: {count, plural, =0 {No duplicates} one {# rule already exists and will be skipped} other {# rules already exist and will be skipped}}
import.unresolved: {count, plural, =0 {Every reference was found} one {# reference was not found} other {# references were not found}}
import.unresolved-hint: A rule naming an account this household does not have is imported switched off. A rule naming a missing category or tag is skipped.
import.replace: {count, plural, one {Replace with # rule} other {Replace with # rules}}
import.done: {count, plural, =0 {No rules imported} one {# rule imported} other {# rules imported}}
import.error: The rules could not be imported.

apply.action-all-hint: Run every active rule over the transactions you already have.
apply.title: Apply “{name}” to existing transactions?
apply.all-title: Apply all rules to existing transactions?
apply.count-error: Your transactions could not be checked right now.
apply.description: {count, plural, one {# existing transaction would change.} other {# existing transactions would change.}}
apply.scope-hint: The rule is judged on its own. Hidden transactions are included; values set by hand and other members' private accounts stay as they are.
apply.all-scope-hint: Active rules run from top to bottom, as on new transactions. Hidden transactions are included; values set by hand and other members' private accounts stay as they are.
apply.confirm: {count, plural, one {Apply to # transaction} other {Apply to # transactions}}
apply.background-hint: You can close this; it keeps going in the background.
apply.continues: The rules keep being applied in the background.
apply.done: {count, plural, =0 {Done: no transactions changed} one {Done: # transaction changed} other {Done: # transactions changed}}
apply.failed: The rules could not be applied. Try again later.
apply.in-progress: Rules are already being applied. Wait for that to finish, then try again.
apply.error: The rules could not be applied right now.

suggestion.title: Always categorize transactions like this as {category}?
suggestion.description: {count, plural, one {You moved # transaction like this in the last {days} days.} other {You moved # transactions like this in the last {days} days.}} A rule can do it for you.
suggestion.dismiss-error: The suggestion could not be dismissed. Try again.
